bundle.shortDescription: Switch Windows Light/Dark theme with one click from the system tray.
bundle.longDescription: Windows Theme Switcher is a lightweight tray utility that lets you switch between fully customizable Light and Dark Windows themes with a single click on the tray icon. It changes Windows Mode, App Mode, transparency, accent color and wallpaper through official Windows registry and API surfaces - no Settings app, no admin rights required.
